summary.text: Brent Siegrist is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 19, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He chairs the Administration and Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brent Siegrist was born in Council Bluffs, Iowa, graduated from St. Albert High School, and earned a B.A. in social science from Dana College.
His career experience includes working as a high school teacher, a coach and a manager of special projects with Valley Corp.
He has served as executive director of the Iowa Association of Area Education Agencies, president of the Iowa Western Community College Board of Directors, and vice president of the Iowa PBS Board.
For 2025-2026 Siegrist chairs the Administration and Rules Committee and serves on the State Government, Transportation, and Ways and Means committees.
